item.title: [LU-20739] RHEL 10.3 support
item.description:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.3 Beta is available.
The latest kernel version is 6.12.0-264.7.1.el10_3.

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: Adding to 2.18 as part of 2.18 release preparation.
Moving to 2.19 for now. It may get added back into 2.18 if 10.3 is GA before code freeze

RHEL 10.3 was released on 2026-11-11.

master (54dc726b56) client modules do not build on AlmaLinux 10.3 (kernel 6.12.0-264.16.1.el10_3). RHEL 10.3 backports half of two upstream changes, and configure assumes both halves arrive together:

1. can_mmap_file(): 10.3 has it (Linux v6.16-rc2-3-gb013ed403197) but still call_mmap(), not vfs_mmap()/vfs_mmap_prepare(). include/lustre_compat/linux/fs.h defines can_mmap_file() under !HAVE_VFS_MMAP_PREPARE, so it is redefined. It needs a check of its own.
2. vfs_mkdir(): 10.3 has inode_operations.mkdir returning struct dentry * (Linux v6.14-rc4-9-g88d5baf69082) but vfs_mkdir() still returns int ("VFS: Change vfs_mkdir() to return the dentry." is not backported). ll_vfs_mkdir() keys on HAVE_IOPS_MKDIR_RETURNS_DENTRY, so pcc_mkdir() assigns an int to a dentry. ll_vfs_mkdir() needs a check on vfs_mkdir() itself.

With both worked around, the client modules build on 10.3. Server side not looked at.

Thank you markus.hilger for the detailed info.
Do you have a patch to fix the above issues?
I just got time back to work on this ticket. If you already have a patch to be pushed to Gerrit, then I can add the client support based on your patch, and then work on the server support patch.

yujian yes check https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/71053

Thank you, markus.hilger.
I'm pushing the client and server support patches.

Security Fix(es) for kernel 6.12.0-264.16.1.el10_3:

  • kernel: sctp: avoid auth_enable sysctl UAF during netns teardown (CVE-2026-68162)
  • kernel: sctp: keep chunk->transport in step with the list it is queued on (CVE-2026-74588)
  • kernel: sctp: clear new_transport when removing a peer (CVE-2026-74586)
  • kernel: sctp: validate cookie AUTH state before use (CVE-2026-74752)
  • kernel: mptcp: options: reset DSS fields in case of unexpected size (CVE-2026-80586)
  • kernel: s390/vfio_ccw: Cancel existing workqueues (CVE-2026-80553)
  • kernel: powerpc/pseries: papr-phy-attest - validate cmd.length, plug mem leak (CVE-2026-80571)
  • kernel: s390/qeth: validate user buffer length in SNMP and ARP query ioctls (CVE-2026-80584)
  • kernel: net/smc: fix use-after-free of the LLC qentry in smc_llc_srv_add_link() (CVE-2026-80981)
  • kernel: smb: client: fix OOB read/write from unvalidated DataOffset in coalesce_t2() (CVE-2026-89633)
  • kernel: sctp: stop processing a packet once its association is deleted (CVE-2026-89479)
  • kernel: i3c: master: svc: bound IBI payload to the requested max_payload_len (CVE-2026-80951)
  • kernel: s390/vfio-ap: Fix missing lock required to access list of ap_matrix_mdev objects (CVE-2026-89956)
  • kernel: ALSA: seq: midi: Serialize input teardown with event_input (CVE-2026-90207)
  • kernel: smb: client: validate absolute native symlink targets before NT fixups (CVE-2026-98318)
  • kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via unvalidated task in iSCSI management responses (CVE-2026-99152)
  • kernel: kernel: Denial of service via unvalidated task tag in iSCSI Reject PDU (CVE-2026-99153)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s) for kernel 6.12.0-264.16.1.el10_3:

  • mpls test multi_path fails on 10.3 CTC2 compose (JIRA:RHEL-222766)
  • RHEL10.0 - kernel: CPU hotplug unsupported by CPUMF [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-270889)
  • Backport 6785011f8b16 ("ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum") [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-280591)
